question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
city_growth AS (
  SELECT cust_city, cust_city_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales
  FROM city_sales
  GROUP BY cust_city, cust_city_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city_id
  FROM city_growth
  WHERE 100.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / q4_2019_sales >= 20
),
prod_city_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id, SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    AND c.cust_city_id IN (SELECT cust_city_id FROM qualifying_cities)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city_id, t.calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(prod_sales) as quarter_sales
  FROM prod_city_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),
prod_total AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN quarter_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2019_sales,
         SUM(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN quarter_sales ELSE 0 END) as q4_2020_sales,
         SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
  FROM prod_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
prod_share AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         q4_2019_sales,
         q4_2020_sales,
         total_sales,
         100.0 * q4_2019_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2019_share,
         100.0 * q4_2020_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2020_share,
         100.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as share_change_pp
  FROM prod_total
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
  FROM prod_share
)
SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp, quintile
FROM ranked_products
WHERE quintile = 1  -- top 20%
ORDER BY share_change_pp ASC
LIMIT 20

         SUM(quarter_sales) as total_sales
  FROM prod_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id
),
prod_share AS (
  SELECT prod_id,
         q4_2019_sales,
         q4_2020_sales,
         total_sales,
         100.0 * q4_2019_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2019_share,
         100.0 * q4_2020_sales / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as q4_2020_share,
         100.0 * (q4_2020_sales - q4_2019_sales) / (q4_2019_sales + q4_2020_sales) as share_change_pp
  FROM prod_total
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp,
         NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as quintile
  FROM prod_share
)
SELECT prod_id, total_sales, share_change_pp, quintile
FROM ranked_products
WHERE quintile = 1  -- top 20%
ORDER BY share_change_pp ASC
LIMIT 20
